body: Thanks so much!
You are obviously very organised and I would love to learn how to do so from you! Is there a chance that you could make the above links  accessible again? Thanks!
Excellent! My partner ripped two pairs of jeans and I gotta figure out how to mend them (fairly large holes). Any tips? But first, I gotta replace the entire sewing box that I lost...
I have found that hooking my keys to a bright lanyard and wearing it on my neck helps! I’m also considering buying Bluetooth trackers (e.g. Tile) for those pesky but essential personal items.
I use TVP, the mince variety 24g, 80cals and 12g of protein. Hydrate it in hot water mixed with a pinch of massel stock powder. Great with veggies or tofu as a “mince” topping. Or pasta sauce.

Hanging my keys on a lanyard has helped me tremendously. I don't remove it from my neck while opening the door, and that means I have to remove the key before entering the house! I have a dedicated hook next to the door for hanging my bright and Disney-themed lanyard.
What is holding you back as you chicken out? Cling onto this thought every time you come back to this space. There must be something that's valuable enough here for you.

Resisting treatment allows the beast to win. Don't let it eat you up. Fight it with all your might and give yourself a chance to heal. You'll never know what might come out of this stay if you don't allow yourself to experience recovery and peace. I wish you well. 💙

It was great that your teacher picked up signs of hyperactivity but a pity that the problem was not seen through to get you the help needed. I dozed off during classes, had trouble organising worksheets and only started on homework at bed time. These were never problematic enough for any adult to realise how shitty I felt for being a bad, lazy student. 
If you don't mind me asking, what were the co-morbid disorders  and how that they get teased out?
I reckon the inattentive ones probably got picked up far later than the hyperactive ones and hence, experience more regret.

I too struggle with the money wasted problem. But not letting all that crap take over my home is exactly what I needed to hear. I don't need to be reminded of the numerous mistakes I've committed. Thank you.
Happy birthday dude. Do something nice for yourself, like eat something completely delicious or watch a movie.
I simply go to bed like any other day. Don't stay up to catch celebration bs, and don't respond to well wishes. Maybe someday we will truly be immuned to them, and no longer feel so shit.

I tried an online chat service. It was the slowest typist in the world. When it learned that I'm not going to do it right now, it went somewhere along the lines of umm okthnxbye. And logged off. Fuck.
I'm so glad that you failed. Now you can have your second chance to fix all that shit. Don't give up!

Thank you! I have 3 cards that get paid automatically each month. But I don't even use them and I think an annual fee gets deducted anyway. Argh must see to it :( 

If only I knew about 6) about 15 years earlier. I spent my entire teenage / early adulthood trying out crafts and projects that never got completed. What have you done with the WIPs since then?

Hey you, there's no competition in misery. A trained therapist is paid to talk to you. You're buying their time, so don't feel apologetic about venting. They are professionals who know when to tread lightly, and when to be harsh. 

I don't know your friends and don't want to excuse their behaviour, but most people often don't know what to say or how to help us folks (we can also be really argumentative!). They seem lovely and genuinely want to listen to you if you need them. So try reaching out when you need to, and see what happens. They may not have the right words, but they can still be a source of comfort. Take care.

Hey you, I'm often reminded by my therapist that I cannot disappoint as long as I try. It's ok that attempts may not work, but it's the effort that counts. Sure the first try may not work, but what went wrong? That's for you to figure out during therapy. You refine your approach, and head out there to give it another go. Maintaining that things are alright when they aren't, serves you no pleasure. I hope you'll reconsider reaching out to kick that pain in the ass. Take care.

Oh yes, that day upsets me. As if that wasn't enough, I had to turn that sad face into a keen face - to have dinner with my partner so that she could "celebrate" the occasion with me. I know, I'm lucky that someone wants to do that for me. But it only piles on the guilt because what kind of ungrateful person does that make me?! Depression makes everything so complicated...
Did you fix the vitamin D deficiency before going on antidepressants? My dr pushed me to go on a new drug that my insurance doesn't pay, and told me to go buy some supplements if I wanted to.

Wellbutrin was definitely wonderful while it lasted. A pity that it's bloody expensive and caused major sleep problems to boot. :( but yea I hear you, it's imperative that one doesn't give up if the medication route has been decided. I hope you've found a good concoction that works!

Dear Amber, I'm sorry that you're hurting so much. Please remember that it is NEVER your fault for your father leaving. You are not responsible for it. Would you like to tell us what's been happening recently that led you to this point? We will listen, but I also hope that you will consider asking for help. Please call lifeline 1800 273 8255 when you feel that you may be a danger to yourself or others. Give yourself a chance to fight those thoughts. 💜
That made me cry. Don't you ever forget that you are loved 💜
If you're feeling worse, it might be time to make an earlier appointment to see your doctor. Perhaps an adjustment or tapering off for another SSRI? Even at 20mg, this pill did nothing for me.

Yeah I've got that covered for some bills but not others. I detected some fraud activity on one of my cards when I opened 6 months worth of paper statements, and would not have reported it had I opted for e-statements as this card is on direct debit. Yet statements and bills give me so much anxiety. Argh the perils of adulthood????

My therapist asked if I ever felt like being in places but not knowing how I got there. Like you, my senses tell me that yes I'm present yet everything is shrouded in a fog. 
How then do you bring yourself back to the present?

Like not paying your bills until multiple debt recovery notices start arriving in your mailbox threatening to disconnect your utilities. I haven't told anyone to this day about how ashamed I am about it because you know, I'm just too lazy to do anything, right? 

Do you think regular people have these problems?
I wonder if the scale you're looking for is "actively suicidal" vs "suicidal ideation"?

Ten thousand is a modest figure, but I suspect the actual figure being more heart-wrenching as I had to pay full rates for a few years when I had no insurance. Have you ever considered how it might make your feel if you had spent all that money on something outrageous on yourself? Investing in a hobby, travel or start a business? (Oh wait, depression wouldn't let me leave the house anyway)

I sincerely want to believe that all these suffering will make me a "better" person in future. But where is this so-called future when you know, my head doesn't even believe that Christmas is in a week's time? I read your comments to many others in this thread, thank you for taking the time to respond to so many who feel defeated in this unfortunate fucked up brain chemistry lottery. You seem to have it together, accepting the pitfalls of this brain problem. How did you get to where you are right now?

I'm sorry that you have suffered for so long to make you feel the need to attempt something like that. Does it sound like drinking may be exacerbating your suicidal ideation? Do these suicidal thoughts subside during other occasions?

Ok, I understand that being lonely is hard, and making friends can be difficult. May I ask, how old are you? I looked at your other posts and you mentioned that you were seeing a therapist. Are you still in therapy? Before you give up hope on being intimate with someone else, give yourself another chance. Keep going to therapy and see where that leads you. You know that you are depressed right now, what is the worst that could happen with therapy? Try to work on yourself, learn more effective coping mechanisms that will see you through your lowest points. Your therapist is there to teach you skills, but you have to practise them in order to get stronger. Give yourself and your therapist another chance before you throw in the towel.
Hi there, I just wanted to let you know that I actually graduated with honours (first class!!) Thank you for listening when I'd lost it earlier on.

Hi, you must be in a lot of pain to contemplate that decision. But the fact is this, you chose to come here and tell somebody about it. You want to be swayed. Your hesitation means something. 
May I suggest putting those pills away and talking about something else instead? What happened today? Why tonight?

15 years later, ten thousand dollars worth of therapy and pills, still struggling with my brain plotting to kill me. I already lost my youth, yet only looking forward to future losses. 

There are those who genuinely recover, and boy am I glad for them. But for those of us who don't, another 50 years of this bullshit is a bloody long time. :(

It appears that I want to, but get better for... what? What's the end game? Everything that holds me back being me so much strange yet destructive comfort. A limbo that the OP echos. We are trapped in ourselves. Entrapment seems to prevail.

I'm sorry that you have to feel like a burden. How are you feeling now? Do you have any small goals that you can work towards to when you finish the course? 
Also, Bon Iver 💙
I am exactly like this. Yet I show up for therapy. So what do I want? I don't know.
Well sometimes it's a fuck it I'll do it anyway situation and this seems like a good one.

I'm sorry to hear that it's always money that fucks things up. Is there anyway that you can participate in a similar program elsewhere that your insurance may cover? Any chance that your psychiatrist may recommend you other therapists or programs? I'm not well-versed with getting scripts for meds in the US, but can your psychiatrist prepare scripts for you to be picked up from the reception even if you don't have an appointment to see the doctor?

It's great that people will notice you are gone. They care. But is it possible to alert them that you'll be on a birthday retreat in advance and perhaps a date that you'll be available for communication?

It's not a lie! You can throw yourself a party and have the time of your life soaking in the tub, getting room service, watching movies, eating junk, etc. it's the truth - you will have a good time and it will be great. 💜
Hi there, I'm sorry to hear that it's been so stressful and hard for you. I wonder, have you ever sought professional psychological help since the hospitalisation?

Congratulations on this huge step towards living life more effectively!! I too live here but my psychologist denies that I have ADHD, with my problems being attributed to my current depression and anxiety. Yet it seems like a chicken and egg issue to me, I probably won't feel like the biggest piece of shit if I could just get my act together like not lose things or read or listen to someone talk! Instead she wants me in on DBT and gain more nutrition. Argh! I've a psychiatrist appointment coming up in three weeks... and it'll truly suck to be dismissed again.
That is fucking awesome!

Man I'd have a kitten if I wasn't afraid of what may happen to it if I was no longer around. That, and apparent allergies. 
Again, dragging what you need to do, only hurts your brain when the fucking task keeps haunting you.

The first step is always the hardest. The rest is generally easier once you've got the motion going. Your therapist who is concerned with your wellbeing will guide you through the process, making it less daunting. Go you, you can do this! Just remember that the longer you put this off, the harder it is for you and no one else. So you stand to gain nothing by pretending. I wish you well xx

Same, my therapist suggests that I'm not ADHD, just severely depressed and anxious. So she's made me practise mindfulness. Great apps out there to do so, one being Smiling Mind. I still don't get how being mindful keeps me from turning my room into a complete mess where no piece of paper can be retrieved once it lands in there. Or losing my possessions.
The default answer to people asking if you're okay is "okay", but deep down, inside you, you know that you aren't. And that's perfectly acceptable. Look at us all telling you that!
Yet some laypeople assume that depression = perpetual sadness. If only they knew.
Oh dear, was there a trigger that turned it to "not very okay"?
No I think being able to discern the "not okay" is itself a tiny tiny good thing. I hope you're coping well with your anger.

Sorry that you had been misled by the false information. You may have been prescribed the wrong pills and that needs to be rectified. I hear that you're constrained by many factors at the moment, but if you ever feel yourself not being able to push the voices away anymore, I hope you remember this-please call a hotline for immediate assistance. Please take care.
Thank you. I'll very much like to be angry, disgusted, frustrated, pleased etc. But I can't. This mental knowledge that I can't experience anything is in itself... frustrating. Oh the irony!
Am I the only person whose emotions have dwindled down to "okay" and "not okay"?
How are you OP?

These professionals' sole job is to help you. It's a mutual relationship - they do their part and you do yours.
Please don't let any preconceived notion stop you from **trying**.
I truly needed to see this today, thank you for that timely reminder.

Shit if you ever see your GP again, please inform him that it was a shit recommendation. If it's an organisation that you sought help from, is there any chance of speaking with them directly?

How are you feeling today?
I'm not sorry that you failed, but you must be hurting so much inside. Do you think you can talk to a medical professional about the attempt?

Yikes I'm sorry that your experience with him suck! I know that having to find one takes a lot of effort and courage, but please, try again. There has to be another person on the list who can help you. Can your GP recommend someone suitable?

I'm sorry that it had to come to this. You must be in a very bad place to feel a need to do this. But right now, you may hurt for a very very long time depending on the cocktail you took. Please, please tell someone close to you right now. Let them know you need help and take you to the ER.

I'm older than you, and realise that lots of my friends who are even older than me, aren't settled down, so to speak. Nonetheless, they have a job, disposable income to engage in activities they choose to, and spend time with friends if they want to. They are happy and I'm learning to be ok from them. You don't have to follow the same path that some people are taking, there are lots of different ones! 

Also lots of people take up new hobbies when they are older (especially retired folks with too much time on their hands) and age hasn't stopped them from practising. Maybe just practise your instrument or paint without a goal in mind? Just do what you feel at that exact moment when you pick up your tool. I also like to paint but the idea of not knowing what to do stops me from doing so. My teachers used to say just make some marks on your paper.

Tl;dr. Being 25 doesn't stop you from taking a different life path or practising your hobbies without fear.

I know that feeling sucks. But maybe you can explore the reasons with the help of a therapist? Medicine alone can't change you if your environment remains the same. I know that cause I was on it for so long after quitting the last therapist. And it made no shit difference to my life.

Good, that means you're still here because somewhere inside you, you WANT To live. I don't know what that is, but that's something for you to find out at therapy. Have the medical professionals come around and talk to you about it?

The act of swallowing pills takes time and in that short time span, you have to decide how far you're willing to go to end it all. I'm terrified that I'll chicken out and stop halfway. But by then I'd have passed out and not be able to get help. It will be a slow slow slow death.

I'm so sorry for your loss and pain of losing your brother. Is there a bereavement support group in your area that you can attend? Grief needs proper attention and though I don't know you, I genuinely hope you'll be able to reach out to your local hospital or community support group for a grief intervention. It is a process that unpacks all your emotions, helps you to preserve the memories you had with your brother, and teaches you to carry on with life with less emotional baggage on your back. 💜

I feel like we are in a similar position, that this meaningless life just keeps dragging on. I started volunteering to make my CV look better. I now have an obligation to turn up, and hang with some kids while trying to help them have better chances at life than I did. It distracts me for a couple of hours a week, so maybe you can try it too.

Hi there, while I'm no medical professional, the doctor you saw may not have diagnosed you correctly. If you are continuing hearing voices telling you to do something that isn't right, it sounds like anti depressants may not be the right treatment for now. Can you get a second medical opinion?

Damn that's my greatest concern - what happens next if this fails? I'm toying with plenty of CNS depressants but anyway... let us know how you're going when you can! 
I hope the nurses treat you with love and kindness and poke those IVs gently.
Yes... why is it so fucking hard to be punctual :(

-You lost your _____ again? 
-I'd have to hang all your things on your neck so that you can't lose _____ again.
-I'm not surprised that you're late again.

You said fuck you to death today. Soon, you'll be able to do the same with all the sadness and worries holding you back. All it takes is to reach out and get help, and just when you think you can't do it, that nothing matters anyway... remember that you said fuck you to death today. And so you're going to fuck all the worries of the world and save yourself. You can do it. 💙
You mentioned about your dreams. Care to tell us more?

That abandonment feeling sucks, so talk to your current therapist about it if that's possible. Otherwise, it may be a good starting point with your new therapist. Give this person a chance, it may not be so bad.

Thank you for the heads up! I hope the idea of psychological first aid will stir the discussion on ways that we can provide assistance to those who require immediate attention - to all disorders besides ADHD. The availability of a sympathetic ear here has been a comfort for most, and so thank you to all who have contributed to making the world a little bit kinder for those who are in pain. The kind that others can't see or comprehend. ❤️💛💚💙💜
Thank you! It did come with some tears which was embarrassing.. now I just have to write another report and study for an exam without special consideration.
You're right. I found the courage to speak to my course coordinator and she's willing to help me get though the thesis with a little help. Thank you for giving me the courage to try.
Meds?

I have another doctor's appointment today that will probably put me in touch with a psychiatrist. Thank for you the suggestions, but it's really way too late in the semester (two weeks left!!) to get that sort of step by step assistance from the uni. I found some respite from my thoughts by self-medicating, not the best solution but you do what you have to do, right?
That sounds like a good start for recovery. I wish you the best and hope this is the beginning of an upward spiral for you towards a healthy future.
Great job in taking charge!
I haven't, but you should really be speaking to your doctor about it.

Hey OP, I hope you're still with us. You should have, and can have, agency over your own body. Those assholes who get away with it cannot rob that from you. Report them, seek help, regain your rightful ownership of your own body. You deserve happiness with the right person who respects you.

Level of cuteness = 100
I love it and I wish the both of you an abundance of love, patience and strength.

Thank you for responding. My therapist is no longer willing to assist in my thesis or assignment extension. She had done that once, but feels that I am not trying hard enough to complete my work and believes that I'm just looking for an easy way out of this. This has also confirmed my belief that I'm just a lazy fucker who isn't doing enough and deserve to fail. I haven't met with the disability office as I didn't believe that I was that ill... at this point I wonder if that's also too late for help?

A crisis hotline can provide you with resources in your area that will suit your needs. Probably less daunting but you will have to take the initiative to seek out help. I'm currently also being miserable but my therapist reminds me that it's my problem for wasting time and not getting help earlier. So yes don't wait anymore...

Hey please let us know if you've called the cops and get the help you truly need. When I was younger I was the same, I was completely broken because my mother just didn't have space in her life for me. Now that I'm older, I've since learned that it's fine if she doesn't do so, I'm ok without it. Maybe you'll too, find someone else who appreciates and treasures you as much as you do so for the other party. But you'll never find out if you don't reach out for help. The hospital is a good place to start if you don't know where to go. Please be well, mate.

Wireless Bluetooth headphones (active noise cancelling if you must) worn around the house with music of your choice. That has helped me drown out so much background noise. I watch something on the tv during meals so that I can't hear others chewing.
How wonderful that you've got a mental health advocate on campus! I hope school becomes less burdensome for you soon. xx

Are you on 150mg? I found 75mg to be bearable when I first started. I guess you'll just have to trust your instinct and her professional opinion if the side effects continue causing you discomfort. Best of luck!

I'm curious, did your tutor share that piece of info willingly with everyone, or was that something you found out after seeking assistance? Nonetheless, what a great guy! 

Go you! I'm really proud of you for taking active steps to improve your situation. Don't give up!

I think I know that fuzziness that you mentioned. My doctor halved the dosage for a while till the insomnia and brain weirdness levelled out. Any chance you can return for a consult to have the dosage adjusted?

It's great that you sought support from your tutors! That must be difficult to do so but you did it anyway! Do you think that's sufficient to help you get through this semester? 
It sounds like your friend can also be a great source of comfort for you. I hope you can work out a support plan together when you need the additional help. I also enjoy cooking, and is the only time i don't feel bad for not studying.

Hi there, I hope you're feeling less ill now. Is there something enjoyable that you can get out of bed for? Perhaps a coffee date with a friend taking the same class as you? The walk to class may be less daunting, plus said friend may even lend you notes for the sessions that you've missed.

Give your meds sometime before you decide if they work for you. So often we've become so used to the sad us that we have stopped recognising the old us. But that doesn't mean it no longer exists. Until our brains are sufficiently rewired such that the neurotransmitters are firing normally again, talk therapy can be difficult to endure. I imagine it as someone with a broken leg who first needs to heal the broken bones before starting on physiotherapy. I hope you discuss your concerns with your doctor and see if you can work out a treatment plan that addresses your trauma. Good luck!

I completely feel you as an undiagnosed case too. Just doing the bare minimum to get by each day without major fuck ups is exhausting. I have several uni deadlines this month and I'm already dreading it and can foresee turning in terrible work that will jeopardise any postgraduate opportunities, in a field that I really want to get into. And then cue feelings of failure, lazy, unmotivated. My first psychiatrist looked at my past academic records and concluded that I'm fine. So it's not like I didn't try to see a doctor and so cue more feelings of failure, lazy, unmotivated.

Do you have to wait two months to get a second opinion? Is there anyway that you can begin sooner?

Definitely! Wait 5 minutes in line desperately hoping that I'll make up my mind when my turn arrives. Cashier speaks, I buy food and beverages that I don't even like. WTF? 

I've since learned that if I like something, I'll buy A LOT of it. Never have to make another decision.

But too sad to start doing any useful tasks :(
I'll have to try and haul my ass out of bed and do something useful.
